ret: 1 training day (A) holding 2 exercises, over block weeks train ×4, once.
Block weeks: train, train, train, train, once. If you miss a session the plan waits: the next session is still the one you missed. Loads on a 2.5 kg grid.
Rotation: Each training week: Day A, then Day A, then Day A.
Attendance (from the rotation): Train at least 3 times in each 7-day window (from your start day). If you don't train for 21 days, attendance stops counting until your next session.
Day A: superset bench and pushStab: rest 0 s between them, then 60 s.
bench: 3 sets of Barbell Bench Press in the phase rep range, starting at the benchStart handed on by the previous phase; add 2.5 kg once every set reaches the top of the range.

pushStab: 2 sets of 12 reps to 20 reps at a slow tempo, on the current rung of Push-Up, Hands on Stability Ball, then Alternating DB Chest Press on Ball, then Single-Leg Standing Cable Press, starting from the rung handed on by the previous phase; climb a rung after 2 sessions in a row with every set done and solid form, up to rung 2.

ret.start: the benchStart handed on by the previous phase

params.benchStart: the benchStart handed on by the previous phase

Reads your estimated max (kept on file; ignored once older than 56 days).

Starts with working weight = whichever is known first: (1) the benchStart handed on by the previous phase; (2) the load you could lift for 12 reps with 2 in reserve, given an estimated max of your estimated max for Barbell Bench Press; written by session, owner.
Plan: Barbell Bench Press: 3 sets of 8–12 reps at your working weight.

After each session: Set working weight to whichever is known first: (1) (if every working set reached the top of its range: your working weight plus 2.5 kg; if a working set fell short: your working weight; if nothing fell short but something went unlogged: your working weight); (2) the best load you logged on “work”.

Reads your form rating (rated after the session).
Starts with rung = the rung handed on by the previous phase; written by session, owner.
Starts with solid sessions in a row = 0; written by session.

Plan: The item at position your rung (from 0) of [Push-Up, Hands on Stability Ball, then Alternating DB Chest Press on Ball, then Single-Leg Standing Cable Press] (holding at the last): 2 sets of 12 reps to 20 reps at tempo 4-2-1-0.

After each session:
    - if every working set reached its target:
      - if your form rating is at least formQuality 2 (no if unknown):
        - if your solid sessions in a row plus 1 is at least 2: Set rung to (your rung plus 1), capped at 2; set solid sessions in a row to 0.
        - otherwise: Raise solid sessions in a row by 1.
      - otherwise: Set solid sessions in a row to 0.
    - if a working set fell short: Set solid sessions in a row to 0.
    - if nothing fell short but something went unlogged: Leave everything as is.
